purpose: Riociguat is used to treat two types of serious lung conditions: pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH) and chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension (CTEPH). These are conditions where the blood pressure in the arteries of your lungs is too high, making it hard for your heart to pump blood properly. This medication helps improve your ability to exercise and slows down how fast the disease gets worse.
how_it_works: Your blood vessels have a natural chemical messenger called nitric oxide that helps relax and widen blood vessels. Riociguat works by boosting the effect of this messenger, which helps relax and open up the blood vessels in your lungs. When those vessels are more open and relaxed, your heart does not have to work as hard to pump blood through them.
common_side_effects: Headache, dizziness, upset stomach, nausea, diarrhea, heartburn, vomiting, low blood pressure, and swelling in the hands or feet are the most common side effects. Some people may also feel faint or lightheaded, especially when standing up quickly.
warnings: This medication can cause serious birth defects and must NEVER be used during pregnancy — women who can become pregnant must use reliable birth control and have regular pregnancy tests. Do not take riociguat with nitrates (like nitroglycerin), erectile dysfunction medicines (like sildenafil or tadalafil), or other blood pressure lowering drugs without your doctor's approval, as this can cause a dangerous drop in blood pressure. Avoid smoking, as it reduces how well this medication works. Tell your doctor right away if you cough up blood or have any unusual bleeding.
typical_dosing: Treatment is usually started at a low dose of 1 mg taken by mouth three times a day (about every 8 hours) with or without food. Your doctor will slowly increase your dose every 2 weeks, up to a maximum of 2.5 mg three times a day, based on how you are tolerating it and how your blood pressure responds. Always take it exactly as your doctor tells you.
